title: Missing check on `toBlock` allows distributors to change past rewards
summary: ## Severity  **Impact**: High, Breaks sequential rewards, can reward same epoch multiple times  **Likelihood**: Medium, Requires malicious distributor/s  ## Description  The function `commit` in `DistributedRewardDistribution.sol` is used to save a reward commit. However this function does not check if the `toBlock` is larger than the `fromBlock`.
